name: LT - UNIPILE LinkedIn Connection Request (Internal Test)

parameters.content:
LT - UNIPILE LinkedIn Connection Request (Internal Test)

Purpose:
- Accept a LinkedIn profile URL or public identifier.
- Resolve it through Unipile to a LinkedIn provider_id.
- Personalize the default note with the resolved first name.
- By default, stop after profile resolution.
- Only send a connection request when send=true is explicitly provided.

Webhook auth:
- Header: x-lt-unipile-key
- Value is stored in the code node config.

Recommended GHL webhook payload:
{
  "linkedin_url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/example/",
  "first_name": "Optional fallback if profile lookup lacks a first name",
  "message": "Optional override. If omitted, the workflow uses the temporary LiveTransparent intro note.",
  "send": false
}

Live send:
- Set "send": true
- Omit "message" to use the default personalized note

GHL contact sourcing is intentionally deferred.
